observation.subject: GET /actuator/health
observation.sentence: `GET /actuator/health`: warm median 2.7 ms over 40 requests; all of them reached no handler BootUI marks (an Actuator endpoint, a request the security filters answered, or a servlet outside Spring MVC), so the time is not split into phases. Recorded calls: Connection wait 0 %. First request 163 ms (cold).
whatToCheck: Open the slowest exemplar request in Live Activity to see its timeline and recorded calls.
limitations: Some requests ran on virtual threads, whose CPU time and allocation the JVM does not report per thread: Profile resources samples them with JFR.
observation.unlistedReason: Its time is not split into phases, since its requests reached no handler BootUI marks or named nothing at all, and its warm median is under 20 ms.
